collection.title: Ford Tourneo Custom 2012 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Ford Tourneo Custom 2012 Onwards requires a 30" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 28" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button Arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a choice of rear screen wipers for this Tourneo which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.

image.alt: Ford Tourneo Custom 2012 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
